Name: Jacky's younger Wizard and Seasonal Clothing
Author: Dobipapa
Description:
The mod itself should be compatible as long as you don't change how the Wizard looks.
The additional file allows you to use my mod with the Cute Seasonal Characters mod as well.

The sprites were made from scrap, both the original wizard, and the color-palette of the Cute Seasonal Characters mod.

The original portrait is from Romanceable Wizard Portrait 2.0 by Ionic's mod. All credits go to them, the seasonal ones were re-made from that one.
